feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 August 2026 10:58am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 04 August 2026 at 11:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong Winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure lies over Northern Ireland, tracking slowly northeastwards.


##Wind##

South or southwest mainly force 4 or 5, but occasionally touching 6 in central and western parts of the area later this afternoon & this evening, before veering west 4 or 5 in all waters early tonight. Then backing west or southwest 5 or 6 by dawn on Wednesday, before increasing 6 or 7 Wednesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate tonight, and moderate or rough Wednesday morning.


##Weather##

Occasional rain and drizzle with areas of mist and fog patches, clearing this afternoon to become mainly fair with only isolated showers, which will become scattered Wednesday morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain, drizzle and mist at first, and very poor in any fog, becoming generally good this afternoon, but occasionally moderate in any showers later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 6 or 7, soon veering west or northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Scattered showers merging into a longer spell of rain for a time before clearing to isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
